notes: The county site www.co.franklin.tx.us links its Elections office to franklincountytxelections.gov. That site answered every request (home page and, after one web search located it, /election-information/election-results/) with an empty HTTP 202 (bot protection); it was not bypassed, so check 2 could not be done. No Clarity site (elections.json 404) and no other vendor results site was found. Search result titles mention a 'March 3, 2026 Primary Results Documents' page, but search text is not evidence. Check 3 pending for all three elections (origin/wayback-data not present). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-H): No change. franklincountytxelections.gov still answers with an empty HTTP 202 (results page and /wp-json/wp/v2/media); not bypassed. Wayback replay and CDX requests for that host were refused by the fetch module (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable). The Wayback harvest covered only co.franklin.tx.us and found no election-night captures. One web search for third-party precinct results found only KETK county pages and an unrelated platinumelectionresults.com 'Franklin County' (it lists a County Coroner race, so not Texas); no check 4 source.
tag_rationale: No election could be determined (the county results site returns empty HTTP 202 responses and check 3 is pending), so the rule gives UNKNOWN.
